intake_scope: Independent station-to-vehicle HRS logger packages received from a public archive or an approved controlled-access custodian.
intake_rule: Hash and quarantine files before numerical values are inspected. Never impute a missing required channel for the primary claim.
claim_boundary: An intake manifest and trace-quality screen prove provenance and data usability only; they are not a model-validation result and cannot close the IJHE readiness gate.
